convert.error.already_flashforge: the project is already set up for a Flashforge printer
convert.warn.nozzle_changed: source nozzle {source} → target {target}; check line widths
convert.warn.filament_unused: {message}; it is not used on any plate, its source values are kept
convert.warn.map_auto_e34: extruders 3–4 are used: the assignment is set to automatic mode because OrcaSlicer rejects manual mode on them; the slicer confirms the planned assignment when slicing
convert.warn.map_manual_e34: the manual assignment uses extruders 3–4: Flash Studio accepts it, OrcaSlicer 2.5 rejects it when slicing
convert.note.volumetric: The target filament allows {cap} mm³/s; the slicer caps these designer speeds by itself, without changing the setting: {items}
reason.gcode_no_equivalent: source G-code with no equivalent in the target
reason.author_on_process: designer's setting on top of the process profile
reason.author: designer's setting
reason.first_layer: project's first layer height (thin objects depend on it)
reason.cooling: cooling depends on the printer's fans; the target profile applies
reason.cooling_no_value: cooling depends on the printer's fans; the target profile applies (no value in the target)
reason.author_filament_replaced: designer's setting for the source filament; the target filament profile applies
reason.filament_printable: each filament can use any of the {count} extruders
reason.extruder_colour: colour of the filament assigned to each extruder
reason.author_on_presets: designer's settings on top of the target presets
reason.invalid_in_orca: value not valid in OrcaSlicer; OrcaSlicer's default applies
reason.recentered: recentred on the target build plate
reason.variant_value: value of the '{variant}' variant (the target has only one)
map.error.entry_numbers: invalid filament map entry '{entry}' (must be numbers)
map.error.repeated: filament {filament} appears twice in the filament map
map.error.missing: the filament map does not assign filaments {filaments}
map.error.unknown: the filament map mentions filaments that do not exist {filaments} (the project has {count})
map.error.out_of_range: the filament map assigns extruders outside 1..{extruders} to filaments {filaments}
map.error.mixed_types: extruder {extruder} gets filaments of different types {types} (filaments {filaments})
map.error.too_many: plate {plate} uses {count} filaments {filaments} but the printer has {extruders} extruders{detail}; assign the extruders manually
map.error.usage_unknown: (usage cannot be determined: colour painting or layer changes)
map.warn.shared_extruder: plate {plate}: filaments {filaments} share extruder {extruder}; a manual spool change is needed during the print
write.error.same_as_source: the output cannot be the original file
write.error.not_zip: the output is not a valid ZIP: {detail}
profiles.error.root_not_found: the slicer profiles folder was not found (tried: {tried}). Use --profiles-dir or the {env} variable.
cli.description: Convert a 3MF project for another printer.
cli.help.map: filament:extruder pairs separated by commas, e.g. 1:1,2:2,5:1
cli.help.out: output file or folder (default: next to the original)
cli.help.report: JSON report path (default: next to the output)
cli.help.force: overwrite the output if it exists
cli.error.original_changed: the original file changed during the conversion
